messages:
leah-w: postmortem follow-up: vendor token throttling impacted model-registry writes and delayed customer rollouts. this is the second auth-maintenance incident this quarter; we need owners + firm ETAs for mitigations. posting a concise action set. please ack and pick items.

dante-m: quick recap: incident began 05:07 UTC, partial degradation at 05:10, resolution at 05:36 after manual retry suppression and a short vendor failover. pattern: vendor maintenance + high-rate deploys.

oncall-ishaan: operational note: reads continued, but writes queued and spiked DB load until we applied backpressure. we used a temporary local queue to drain writes safely.

leah-w: proposed action items (reply with owner + ETA):
- vendor maintenance SLA & advanced calendar request (formal contract ask) -> owner: contracts-maya -> ETA: 10d
- design and implement multi-issuer token failover (probe + automatic switch) -> owner: dante-m -> ETA: 3w
- implement local idempotent write-queue + background apply to reduce write pressure -> owner: dante-m -> ETA: 2w
- SDK protection: cached-token reads + retry-with-jitter for writes -> owner: dante-m -> ETA: 7d
- observability: alert when token error rate >4% for 3m and registry write-fail-rate spikes -> owner: oncall-ishaan -> ETA: 48h
- deployment policy: add pre-deploy check to block big batches during vendor maintenance windows -> owner: oncall-ishaan -> ETA: EOW
- runbook: include escalation steps and short customer-comm template -> owner: leah-w -> ETA: 4d

contracts-maya: taking vendor escalation. will request maintenance calendar and stronger SLA language. will CC account rep today. ETA 10d for contract reply.

dante-m: taking failover + queue + SDK. plan: SDK retry PR in 24h, queue prototype in 5d, failover probe doc by EOW and initial probe code in 2w. linking to INC-8104.

oncall-ishaan: will add alert rules and the deploy gating mechanism. will also schedule a recurring monthly dependency review.

ops-bot: created INC-8104 - "auth-dependency resilience follow-ups" assigned to dante-m, oncall-ishaan. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8104

leah-w: two prioritization notes: 1) multi-issuer failover + vendor calendar are highest priority given recurrence; 2) SDK + queue are quick wins to lower immediate blast radius. if no objections I'll mark INC-8104 P0.

dante-m: agree. will prioritize failover probe.

contracts-maya: ack. escalating calendar ask now.

oncall-ishaan: ack. scheduling 15m follow-up Mon 10:00 to check blockers and initial PR links. update INC-8104 if you reassign. :thumbsup:
